#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const long long INF = 1000000000000000001LL;

long long nCr[200][200];
long long dp[200][200][2];
long long dist[200][200][2];

struct Tuple {
    long long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple(long long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

long long f(long long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p = (p * nCr[a][b]) % MOD;
    p = (p * nCr[c][d]) % MOD;
    return p;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;

    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i)
                nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 50)
            cnt1++;
        else
            cnt2++;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
            dist[i][j][0] = INF;
            dist[i][j][1] = INF;
            dp[i][j][0] = 0;
            dp[i][j][1] = 0;
        }

    dist[cnt1][cnt2][0] = 0;
    dp[cnt1][cnt2][0] = 1;

    queue<Tuple> q;
    q.push(Tuple(0, cnt1, cnt2, 0));

    while (!q.empty()) {
        Tuple cur = q.front();
        q.pop();
        int x = cur.x, y = cur.y, z = cur.z;
        long long d = dist[x][y][z];

        if (z == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= y; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    long long ways = f(dp[x][y][z], x, i, y, j);
                    int nx = x - i, ny = y - j, nz = 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.push(Tuple(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz));
                        }
                        dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rx = cnt1 - x, ry = cnt2 - y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rx; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= ry; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    long long ways = f(dp[x][y][z], rx, i, ry, j);
                    int nx = x + i, ny = y + j, nz = 0;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.push(Tuple(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz));
                        }
                        dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[0][0][1] == INF) {
        cout << -1 << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << dist[0][0][1] << "\n";
    }
    cout << dp[0][0][1] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
